options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: auth_privacy
options.description: Supported SNMP privacy protocol. C(Nil) - No encryption on the wire. C(AES256) - means Encryption class for AES 256. C(TDES) - Encryption class for Triple Data Encryption.

options.name: auth_protocol
options.description: Relevant only for SNMPv3. Supported SNMP authentication protocols. C(Nil) - No authorization. C(MD5) - The AuthMD5 class implements the MD5 authentication protocol. C(SHA256) - The Secure Hash Authentication.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the SNMP manager. IPv4 and IPv6 are supported.

options.name: new_ip_address
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the SNMP manager to update. IPv4 and IPv6 are supported.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: snmp_password
options.description: Passphrase, used for both Authentication and Privacy protocols. I(snmp_password) is only applicable when I(version) is C(V3) and to set the security level to authentication only and authentication and privacy.

options.name: snmp_port
options.description: Port number to use with the address of the SNMP manager.

options.name: snmp_username
options.description: User name for SNMP auth. I(snmp_username) is required when I(version) is C(V3).

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the file DNS should be enabled or not. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: trap_community
options.description: Trap Community string describes the security level. I(trap_community) is required when I(version) is C(V2c).

options.name: update_password
options.description: Update password applicable only to fir update case.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: version
options.description: Supported SNMP protocol versions. C(V2c) - SNMP version 2c. C(V3) - SNMP version 3.
